Voter Registration Office
The Voter Registration Office oversees the administration of all elections, candidate filings and campaign finance. The Voter Registration Office, along with the County Commissioners, manages all polling place assignments and maintains all precinct information.
Candidate Info
Candidate Pre-Election Report (CFA-4) Due January 21st by Noon.
Candidates that have filed to run for office must file this report even if they were not on the primary ballot.
Reports can be emailed to the Voter Registration Office at elections@jeffersoncounty.in.gov

Early Voting will be at the Jefferson County Courthouse Commissioner's office (1st floor). All registered voters in Jefferson County can take advantage of early voting. There does not have to be a reason to cast an early vote.

Anyone wanting to have an Absentee Ballot sent to their home can do so by contacting the Voter Registration Office or by going online to indianavoters.com. The deadline for a voter to submit and ABS Application is October 22nd by midnight. The application can be mailed (300 E Main Street) or faxed (812-273-5428) or emailed to elections@jeffersoncounty.in.gov . You can contact the Voter Registration Office at 812-265-8926
Absentee Ballot Application
If you have any further questions about absentee ballots, please email the Voter Registration Office at elections@jeffersoncounty.in.gov

From: Tabatha Eblen, Jefferson County Clerk
Re: Information for the Upcoming Election
Anyone interested in checking their voter registration status can go to www.indianavoters.in.gov . The site allows a person to register to vote, check voting status, find your polling location, and view who’s on the ballot.
The site has a drop down option that allows a voter to select democrat or republican to find which candidate is on the ballot. You can also find information on what identification you will need on Election Day. Simply, enter your information to find your polling location or voting status, and then look for the hyperlink "What Do I Need to Vote at the Polls".
For additional information, contact Tabatha Eblen at the Clerk’s Office, 812-265-8926
__________________________________________________________________________
From: Tabatha Eblen
Re: Primary Election Party Affiliation
The Jefferson County Voter Registration Office has received several phone calls regarding party affiliation. An Indiana registered voter is not registered to vote as a Republican or Democrat. All registered voters have the option to pull a Democrat or Republican ballot in the Primary Election no matter what was voted in previous elections.
If you have any further questions regarding this matter, please contact the Voter Registration Office at 812-265-8926. For the Clerk's Office, please call 812-265-8922
